articles.summary: XpertLINC combines the flexibility and adaptability of a human operator with the consistency and repeatability of a robot Lincoln Electric (Nasdaq: LECO) today announced the launch of XpertLINC ™, a proprietary physical AI-enabled technology platform that integrates vision, coordinated motion, process control, and decades of welding expertise in one package. XpertLINC dynamically adjusts a robot’s path and welding parameters to adapt on the fly like a human would, delivering higher productivity and better quality, even with inconsistent parts, while adhering to customers’ process specifications. Lincoln Electric's new XpertLINC™ physical AI technology platform is redefining the future of automated welding. The platform eliminates the need for programming or CAD files by using sensors, coordinated motion, process control, and decades of welding expertise to control the robot and dynamically adjust its path and welding parameters to adapt to part variability. articles.summary: Marks the Company’s 31st Consecutive Annual Dividend Increase Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. , (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LECO) announced today that its Board of Directors approved a 10 percent increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.87 per share, or $3.48 per share of common stock on an annualized basis. The dividend is payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 31, 2026. “Our annual dividend increase underscores our confidence in the execution of our RISE strategy, the Company’s strong cash generation, and how well-positioned we are for long-term growth,” said Steven B. Hedlund, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “Our dividend remains an important component of our capital allocation strategy and reflects our commitment to returning value to our shareholders.” Lincoln Electric has paid a cash dividend every quarter since going public in 1995 and has increased its dividend annually for 31 consecutive years.
